messages:
sam: Quick idea: "progressive-fidelity" policy. Start replies at FP8 to keep anchor quality, then step down to INT8/4-bit for low-novelty segments to save cost. Thoughts? cc @ivy @pat

ivy: neat. How do we measure novelty? rolling token entropy or overlap with recent tokens?

sam: MVP: rolling unigram novelty over last 64 tokens. novelty in [0,1]. policy: >0.6 -> fp8, 0.3-0.6 -> int8, <0.3 -> 4bit. Start with conservative thresholds.

pat: runtime constraints: can't mutate kv cache format across variants. Either separate cache namespaces per-variant or forbid mid-conv format changes. We should pin variant per-conv once cached keys exist.

charlie: ops/observability asks: surface header X-Precision-Policy: progressive-v1 and traces: precision.current, precision.history, novelty.score, trigger_reason. Also include sample.id for A/B.

ivy: need shadow baseline: keep fp8 shadow for 2% of requests so we can compute deg_delta. Alert if mean deg_delta > 0.07 or 99p > 0.12.

sam: good. rollout plan: local sim -> staging shadow 1% for 24h -> canary 3% on non-critical endpoints -> expand. Add an immediate kill switch if alerts fire.

pat: small perf note: 4-bit kernels are slower on tiny batches. Add runtime guard: if batch_size<4 OR seq_len<16 then skip 4bit (use int8).

charlie: telemetry schema proposal: ["precision.variant","precision.history","novelty.score","batch_size","seq_len","kv_namespace","degscore.shadow","degscore.live","latency.p95","tokens_generated","sample.id"]. Will tag by endpoint & customer_tier.

sam: API boundary: don't change model manifest. Add optional request field: precision_policy: "progressive-v1" plus tunables (anchor_tokens=128, eval_window=64, thresholds). Runtime enforces cache rules.

pat: compatibility: when resuming convs across restarts pin policy.seed = hash(conv_id) so decisions deterministic. Also record policy.seed in conv metadata for replay.

deploy-bot: deploy: scheduled staging rollout with feature_flag=progressive_precision at 02:00 UTC. Monitor novelty.score distribution and precision.variant ratios for first 10m. :eyes:

ivy: action items: @pat draft cache compatibility appendix, @charlie add telemetry fields to schema, @sam write RFC follow-up with pseudocode and sim plan. Hold prod deploy until QA signoff.

sam: I'll run a synthetic drift replay and post degscore vs fp8 shadow results in the RFC thread. Thanks everyone!
